issues.description: The problem statement requires implementing init_world(width, height) to set both dimensions, but the provided template does not include any init_world stub and the solution's init_world implementation only reads a single parameter (width). This mismatch between the specified function signature (two parameters) and the actual solution (handles only one) — combined with the absence of a template stub — can confuse students about the required signature and behavior.
issues.suggestedFix: Add a clear init_world stub in the template with the expected signature (init_world: that accepts width and height on the stack) and/or update the solution to handle both width and height (e.g., read both [esp+4] and [esp+8]). Also ensure the problem statement and solution agree on the exact parameter handling so students know which values to set.
